name: competitor-research
description: Three-phase competitive intelligence: discover true competitors via capability cluster analysis, research TikTok presence, and generate a combined competitor analysis report
author: Shortflow
capabilities: Identify true competitors via Gemini with Google Search grounding and capability cluster analysis
Classify competitors into tiers (direct, partial overlap, behavioral substitute) by capability overlap
Research each competitor's TikTok presence (handles, followers, videos, content strategy, viral videos)
Generate a markdown competitor analysis report combining competitive intelligence with TikTok presence
Verify user-provided competitor lists and exclude non-competitors with reasoning
Distinguish decision-layer vs tool-layer products to avoid false competitor identification
